ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, it is a transition-state structure, with one nitrogen-containing five-membered heterocycle on each of the left and right sides; double bonds are drawn in each five-membered ring, but count one by one according to the heavy-atom connections in the structure. One N of the left five-membered ring is connected to the central carbon, and one N of the right five-membered ring is also connected to the central carbon. The central carbon is also connected to S-H and an O; this O is connected downward to a carbon, this carbon has R attached and continues to connect to the next carbon; the next carbon has R1 and OH attached. There are curved arrows in the figure, but the question requires ignoring the arrows. Reasoning: count according to the specified components. The left five-membered ring has 5 heavy-atom bonds within the ring, plus 1 bond from this ring N to the central carbon, for a total of 6. The right five-membered ring also has 5 heavy-atom bonds within the ring, plus 1 bond from this ring N to the central carbon, for a total of 6. The remaining non-ring heavy-atom bonds are: central C-S, central C-O, O-lower carbon, lower carbon-R, lower carbon-next carbon, next carbon-R1, next carbon-O in OH, a total of 7. Exclude S-H and O-H, and ignore arrows. Therefore the total is 6 + 6 + 7 = 19.

raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: Count by components. From the image, count 5 heavy-atom bonds around the left five-membered ring plus 1 bond from its N to the central carbon. Count 5 heavy-atom bonds around the right five-membered ring plus 1 bond from its N to the central carbon. Then count the remaining non-ring heavy-atom bonds: central C-S, central C-O, O-lower carbon, lower carbon-R, lower carbon-next carbon, next carbon-R1, and next carbon-OH oxygen. Exclude S-H and O-H and disregard arrows. Sum the component counts: 6 + 6 + 7 = 19.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是一个过渡态结构，左右各有一个含氮的五元杂环；每个五元环中都画有双键，但按结构中的重原子连接逐条计数。左侧五元环的一个 N 连接到中心碳，右侧五元环的一个 N 也连接到中心碳。中心碳还连接到 S-H 和一个 O；该 O 向下连接到一个碳，该碳连有 R，并继续连接到下一碳；下一碳连有 R1 和 OH。图中有弯箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头。推理：按指定组件计数。左侧五元环环内有 5 条重原子键，再加上该环 N 到中心碳的 1 条键，共 6 条。右侧五元环环内也有 5 条重原子键，再加上该环 N 到中心碳的 1 条键，共 6 条。剩余非环重原子键为：中心 C-S、中心 C-O、O-下方碳、下方碳-R、下方碳-下一碳、下一碳-R1、下一碳-OH 中的 O，共 7 条。排除 S-H 和 O-H，忽略箭头。因此总数为 6 + 6 + 7 = 19。
